segments.name: Ecommerce acceleration
segments.description: Operates an ecommerce acceleration platform and uses on-demand experts to sell brand partners' products to consumers on global marketplaces.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its business on a consolidated basis and operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Brand partners supply products that the company buys and resells to consumers on global ecommerce marketplaces, earning revenue from those consumer product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the substantial majority of our revenue from consumer product sales on global ecommerce marketplaces.
